subject.title: Generate secretref reference docs from secret target registry metadata

question: Which open SecretRef docs-generation PR should be the canonical fix for this issue?
rationale: The requested work remains valid, but two open PRs implement overlapping generator/check paths and neither has merged into current main.

options.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
options.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

options.title: Repair same-author closing PR
options.body: Ask https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/91612 to address proof and formatter concerns, resolve conflicts, and land that branch instead.

options.title: Request one replacement
options.body: If neither branch is worth adopting, close or pause the competing PRs and request one fresh focused generator/check PR.

recommendation.title: Refresh stronger proven sibling
recommendation.body: Refresh https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89142 on current main, resolve conflicts, rerun proof, and use it as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent stabilization history on the credential matrix docs surface and is the best available routing owner for choosing the implementation path.
